name: Pupau AI Assistant
author: gluelabs

sections.description:
Pupau AI is a platform that allows you to create extraordinary Agents. This plugin enables you to add your Pupau Agents to your website. The plugin is also compatible with Multilingual Environment (via WPML, Polylang, Weglot ) allowing you to use specific Agents for specific Customer Base based on the language

Use of Third-Party Services

The Pupau AI Assistant plugin relies on a third-party service to provide Pupau functionalities. Here are the details:

  • Service: Pupau AI Assistant

  • Circumstances of use: This plugin integrates a web component that allows users to interact with a Pupau Agent. Conversation data may be sent to the Pupau service to process responses and improve the user experience.

  • Terms of use: Link to Pupau service terms of use

  • Privacy policy: Link to Pupau service privacy policy
sections.installation:
Install the plugin and configure your Pupau API key.
Pupau: access your Pupau dashboard, select or create an assistant, and in the configuration section, go to the “Client and Integration” tab where you can create a new API key.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API KEY?

You need to be a Pupau user. Go to https://pupau.ai, sign up, and choose the subscription plan that best suits your needs of consult the Official Documentation
